## Appearance

Rilla Blythe has curly red hair styled in long, sleek, ruddy curls. Her eyes are hazel.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## History

As a child at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), Rilla was cared for by her mother, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md). While bringing a basket of strawberries to the manse, she was frightened by [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) with a dried codfish, causing her to fall into a mud puddle. She was subsequently rescued from the puddle by Miss Cornelia, who brought her home.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER VII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rilla-blythe.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Rilla's mother. They live together at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends quiet evenings watching over Rilla and the other children alongside their housekeeper, [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md). When Rilla gets frightened by [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) and falls into a mud puddle, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins Miss Cornelia and [Susan](../character/susan.md) in discussing the incident after Rilla is brought safely home.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), +11 more_
